whatIs: Icoon is a store of AI-generated graphic assets: 3D icons, illustrations, mockups and images for websites, apps, landing pages and print. Files come in SVG, PNG and editable PSD, and there's a mockup generator and a section of free assets.
It's a good fit when you need illustrations or 3D icons with an eye-catching style for a landing page or a product, without hiring an illustrator.
uses: Illustrating a landing page hero with a 3D icon in PNG.
Using SVG illustrations on an onboarding screen or in an app's empty states.
Tweaking an asset in the editable PSD to match a client's brand.
caveats: You can't resell or distribute the assets separately, or sell them individually without substantially modifying them.
Purchases can't be returned or refunded, so look through the catalog carefully before you pay.
It's not a UI icon library with an npm package; these are assets you download and place by hand.
pricingNote: There are free assets; access to the whole catalog costs $29 as a one-time payment (a sale price versus $59), with a commercial license.
idealFor: Landing pages and products that need ready-to-use illustrations and 3D icons.
